page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, left column then right column. Running head "ת ש" centred above each column. Page number 463 top right. Catchword "תשם" at lower right.

main_text.l: תָּשִׂים pones, תְּשִׁימֵנִי me, תְּשִׁימֻנוּ nos, תָּשִׂימוּ ponetis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. & 2. pl. m. Rad. שׂוּם.
תָּשִׁיר cantabis, vel bit, תָּשִׁירוּ cantabitis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. fing. fæm. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. שׁוּר.
תָּשֵׂשׂ gaudebis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. שׂשׂ.
תָּשִׁית pones, תָּשִׁיתוּ ponetis, תְּשִׁיתֵהוּ pones eum, תְּשִׁיתֵהוּ eos, תְּשִׁיתֵנִי me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. & pl. m. ut & 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּת.
תִּשְׁכַּבְנָה concubitu violabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. fæm. Rad. שָׁכַב.
תִּשָּׁכַח oblivioni traderis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁכַח.
תִּשְׁכִּים surges mane, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁכַם.
תַּשְׁכֵּן habitare facies, pro תַּשְׁכִּין, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁכַן.
תִּשְׁכֹּנָּה habitabitis, vel bunt, pro תִּשְׁכֹּנָּנָה, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שָׁכַן.
תִּשְׁכְּרִי inebriabis te, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. R. שָׁכַר.
תִּשְׁלֶג nivesces, vel cet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁלַג.
תַּשְׁלָה errare facies, vel faciet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁלָה.
תִּשְׁלוּ spoliabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. שָׁלַל.
תִּשָּׁלוּ errabitis, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. R. שָׁלָה.
תַּשְׁלִימֵנִי perficies me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁלַם.
תִּשְׁלְכִי abjicieris, pro תָּשְׁלִכִי, fut. Hoph. 2. f. f. Rad. שָׁלַךְ.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are read from a small scan and may be wrong in places; the consonantal forms are the safer reading. Entry "gaudebis" (line 3 left) and the points in "תִּשְׁכֹּנָּה" and "תִּשְׁלוּ" are uncertain. The Hebrew of the catchword and the running heads is read as printed. Long s is copied as plain s.
